cohort: The study included 134 infants diagnosed with congenital muscular torticollis who were refractory to conservative management.
finding: Botulinum toxin type A injections were effective in 61% of infants with refractory congenital muscular torticollis, with only 4 patients (3%) eventually requiring surgical correction.
